business.name: Fairfield Inn & Suites New Orleans Downtown/French Quarter Area

ranking.name: Fairfield Inn & Suites New Orleans Downtown/French Quarter Area

text.text_excerpt: Nice location, but I wasn't exactly French Quarter. My room was nice and you could tell the hotel has been renovated from whatever it was before. If you look up in the room you see the beams. That added a classic touch to the room. Parking was kind of expensive, but there are other options close by. There is also a restaurant connected, so if you don't want to go out you don't have to. There is a coffee shop across the street for morning specialty coffees. My bed was huge and I wish my wife had been there with me. Bathroom was modern with a roomy shower. Breakfast was good, and they had the same food that all Marriott properties serve. Sausage, eggs, cheese. I opted for the granola cereal...

Recently stayed at this hotel and overall really enjoyed it and would stay here again. It was just a 15-20 minute walk to French Quarter which is completely doable and necessary when eating and drinking everything in sight in NOLA. The Good: ~Free breakfast from 630-10am weekdays and 7-10am on the weekends. Breakfast was very respectable with apple juice, orange juice, coffee, two kinds of sausage (where was the bacon), two kinds of milk (where was the chocolate milk?), scrambled eggs, cheese omelettes, make your own waffles, toast, bagels, cereal, muffins including chocolate! ...Really there were many, many options that filled us up just fine until lunch. ~Really nice, really clean room ...

I love when a city reuses old buildings instead of demolishing them. I appreciate the old beams in the rooms. What I also appreciate is how clean the rooms are and how comfy the beds were. The proximity to The French Quarter is easily walkable and parking easy due to garages close by. While the complimentary breakfast is not gourmet, it does the trick. A family of 5 can save $50 by taking advantage of the yogurt, waffles, eggs, sausage, English muffins, cereal, oatmeal,fruit, juice, coffee, tea and hot chocolate.
